title: Dispute over whether Ray Charles played on Slim's session
summary: The interviewer says Ray played piano on Things I Used to Do; Stovall, who was at the session, disputes it.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Well I know he worked, he was in and around New Orleans.
Yeah, well during that time, when he actually got big then, he was with Rip Robert then. You know, Rip was the biggest type then.
You know what I'm saying is he worked on one of the split sessions on the things I used to do. On his recording? Things I used to do, he played piano.
Somebody told you that? No, I know he did.
You did? I know he was on that. He was on that recording. I was wondering how he came to be on the recording.
How do you know he's on the recording?
Well, a number of people told me.

Well I was at the session and Ray and I are very good friends. And I didn't see him on the session. That's why I asked you how you knew he was on the session. They cut him over here. At that time, Carson had a studio on North Ramport Street. Johnny Benson told me that Ray was on the piano. Well if they did, they built the piano after you cut the session. I can't tell you what they have, but he went on the session here in New Orleans. Johnny Benson was the one. Do you know who played piano then?
Well, they took him to California and took him to California and took him to California and built the piano in. He wasn't here on the session here. He was not on the session.
On the things I used to do. Not here in the city of New Orleans. It was cut right here on special on North Ramport Street. Cosmo had a studio there. I don't know.
Oh, was Johnny Benson told me that? Johnny Benson cut him.
Johnny Benson on the way. Well if they did, they built the piano in after you cut the session. I can't tell you what they have, but he went on the session here in New Orleans.
Johnny Benson was the one. You don't play piano then?

Are you... I don't remember. It seemed like me it was Dave Atharmya band. I don't remember. I don't remember. I'm not for sure. I think it was Dave Atharmya band that bagged him up. Dave Atharmya had a band. I'm not sure about that. But Ray Charles wasn't on the session. If they did, they went back to California and did the session. They carried the synth to him and cut the session over and I didn't know that about. Cos I was still managing then, you see.
